name: finpack-claude
description: Lean, token-efficient agents and skills for daily Claude Code development. Install the whole kit by cloning the repo, or pick individual plugins from this marketplace.

plugins.name: fp-agents
plugins.description: Nine focused engineering agents: code/security/performance/doc/plan review, frontend + SwiftUI design, architecture, exploration.

plugins.name: setup-finpack
plugins.description: Bootstrap and customize finpack-claude in any project. Copies the full template into .claude/ if missing, then tunes every config file to match your stack.

plugins.name: explain
plugins.description: Explain code with one-sentence summary, mental model, ASCII diagram, and modification guide.

plugins.name: summon-seer
plugins.description: Summon the seer to divine recurring friction in recent Claude Code sessions, then propose new skills, automations, and CLAUDE.md fixes. Report-only unless --fix.

plugins.name: quest-system
plugins.description: RPG-themed epic and session management for mono-repo development.

plugins.name: install-quest-system
plugins.description: Bootstrap quest-system in any project. Copies all seven command files to .claude/commands/ in one step.

plugins.name: update-quest-system
plugins.description: Update installed quest-system files to the latest version from source or GitHub. Overwrites command files, skills, the fp- agent suite, and the verifier hook.
